svg.title: Oracle Forms Migration Fleet pipeline on Azure
svg.desc: Customer-authorized Oracle Forms and database evidence flows through deterministic normalization, Microsoft Foundry assisted review, application generation, and compiler-led validation. Artifacts and reports are written to an isolated session workspace.
svg.text: Evidence-led modernization pipeline · deterministic gates · Microsoft Foundry assistance · compiler authority
Claim boundary: the fleet reads operator-produced Forms XML and textual database evidence. Proprietary Forms binaries are inventoried but not decoded in-process.
Implemented development path shown in solid lines. Model output cannot approve, attest, select credentials, or overrule compiler/test failures.
